taste:
The deep comedy of Tim Heidecker, Marc Maron, Louis C.K. and Bill Burr.
That means dark, personal or confessional material, long rants with a strong point of view, or deadpan absurdism.
Not into raunchy comedy at all, but not afraid of it: filth or shock never raises a rating.
An act that is mostly sex or shock material is a different style, or a partial fit when it also has real depth.
note: Written by rate.py with the claude backend. The model answered from general knowledge; reasons are not verified. An empty entry means the model did not know the name.
